defect: an asynchronous select directly gates and multiplexes two unrelated clocks
rationale: sel_ctrl can change while either clock is active, allowing a runt pulse or overlapping clock transition at clk_out.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Clock mux select sel_ctrl is unsynchronised to either clock and the gate-level mux can glitch or produce runt pulses when it changes.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the generic two-clock mux expression and reduced assertions and technology-specific buffering to a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Used sel_ctrl directly in the combinational clock selection expression without break-before-make gating or per-clock synchronization.
